correctness.rationale: All t and n quantifiers are explicit. Conditioning on k uniform relocation starts turns the no-repetition event into an anchored labeled-circle packing count of k! binom(n-t-1+k,k) tuples, giving the finite formula. Strict parameter monotonicity follows from conditional survival ratios. Poisson convergence proves the finite-rate distribution including its atom at the deterministic full-lap time; binomial concentration and an O_p(K t^2/n^2) expansion establish the many-relocation Rayleigh law. Exact-rational finite dynamic programming and direct path enumeration pass 438 checks; finite tests are supporting checks, not the asymptotic proof.

evidence: The semi-deterministic resetting paper gives motion on the integers alternating deterministic steps and returns to the initial state; its exact quantities concern exit times and stationary state.
The network resetting paper explicitly assumes an undirected adjacency and resets to one fixed node; it calculates stationary and target-hitting probabilities.
The Markov-chain birthday paper concerns near-stationary sampling and birthday-collision algorithmic complexity, not first-repeat path survival for a prescribed transition kernel.
The circular-arc work makes gap counting plausible as a known component, but no checked full-text statement covers this random-reset survival distribution.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: None of the inspected central theorems directly implies the displayed finite-time Bernoulli-mixture formula or both normalized limiting laws without building the specific circular scan decomposition. The geometric count is credited as a tool rather than characterized as a new stand-alone result.

evidence: Villarroel–Montero–Vega, 2021, model and first passage sections, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8303408/: relocation is to the original site, not independent uniformly chosen sites.
The present event is no repetition anywhere in a path, rather than first arrival at one fixed site.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Replacing random relocation by fixed-origin resetting changes the conditional spatial occupancy: after k resets, all runs start at the same site, so the circular gap bijection with k independent uniform starts does not apply. The statement is not an equivalent rewriting of a fixed-target first-passage formula.

residual_risks: The older Siegel–Holst circle-arc report was not read in full; it may contain a comparable discrete gap-count identity, which is treated here as a building block, not as a novel final claim.

value.rationale: The model is a natural interpolation from deterministic cyclic surveying to independent uniform sampling. The exact survival polynomial determines finite reliability, exhibits strict stochastic degradation under more relocation, and exposes a sharp order-1/n parameter window with a surviving full-lap atom; above it the first-repeat scale and collision coefficient are explicit. These are whole-process first-repeat properties not given by stationary or individual target-hitting distributions.
